insights.title: ₹9.8L Free-Rider Waste in Snacks & Grocery
insights.description: Two promotions in Grocery & Staples are bleeding ₹6.0L combined due to 57-58% free-rider ratios — loyal buyers stockpiling on BOGO offers instead of new customer acquisition. Weekend Snack Bundle shows 62% free-riders with ROI of only 1.4×.
insights.action: Immediately gate Eid Essentials and Oil BOGO to new-to-brand/lapsed segments. Switch Oil BOGO to bundle mechanic (Saffola + spice combo). Projected recovery: ₹6.0L this week.

insights.title: Scale Loyalty Gold Cashback Model Chain-Wide
insights.description: Personal Care cashback campaign delivering 3.7× ROI with only 31% free-riders and ₹17.8L net incremental revenue on ₹5.7L spend. Lift of 28% with minimal post-promo dip (-4%) vs. bundle promotions showing -14% hangover.
insights.action: Replicate cashback mechanic to Grocery staples (rice, oil, pulses) and Home Care. Target 40-50% budget reallocation from underperforming BOGO/bundle offers to cashback in Q2.

insights.title: ₹6.2L Cost Passthrough Gap Eroding Margins
insights.description: Shelf prices not updated despite cost inflation. India Gate Basmati 5kg cost up 8% but price unchanged — margin compressed to 12.0% vs. target. Total passthrough gap: ₹6.2L across portfolio this week.
insights.action: Execute urgent price review on staples (rice, oil, pulses). Raise India Gate Basmati by ₹30 immediately. Automate cost-to-shelf lag alerts to prevent future margin erosion.

insights.title: Promo ROI Surging But Margin Realization Falling
insights.description: Promo ROI jumped from 2.48× to 3.52× week-over-week, but margin realization dropped 1.4 points to 79.47% and sell-through is 5.17% below target at 69.83%. ₹39.9L inventory at markdown risk indicates overstocking on promoted SKUs.
insights.action: Tighten inventory planning on high-velocity promo SKUs. Reduce order quantities by 15-20% on Snacks/Grocery promos with >50% free-rider ratios to prevent markdown cycle.
